draft_entry.summary: Google DeepMind reports releasing Genie 4, a world model that generates interactive simulations with native audio, including music, ambient sound, and dialogue. Access is a research preview for trusted testers, starting with Google AI Ultra subscribers in Project Genie and early access partners of the Gemini API and Google AI Studio, with a waitlist open. The announcement reports no benchmark figures and links no system card, model card, usage policy, or paper.

signals.title: Genie 4: A new generation of world simulation
